Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice (intent to burn or reckless disregard of an obvious fire risk); inadvertently forgetting the stove is mere negligence.

Q9000.reason: GA resolutions are not binding formal sources; they are material sources that may evidence or enunciate customary law depending on content, voting, and state practice.

Q9002.reason: “Provided that if… may re-enter” creates a right of entry, so the state holds a fee simple subject to condition subsequent rather than an estate that ends automatically.
